text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of the fan appreciation 
event... The academy's stage was bustling 
with little kids.

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaand up next is our 'Play with the 
Racing Big Sisters!' corner~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawa... C-Can I really keep up with 
everyone...? But still—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Anyone who wants to play tag, 
gather round meee!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I wanna be 'it', I wanna be 
'it'!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Urara-san fits right in so naturally... 
I-I have to do my best and reach out too!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-Heeey there, everyoneee~! Would you 
l-like to play with Big, Big Sis Doto~...?

text_block_list.name: Precocious Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's with you, big sis? You wanna 
hang out with us or something?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fueh!? Y-Yes, please...!

text_block_list.name: Precocious Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Guess we could let you join the 
gang. What do you say, Boss?

text_block_list.name: Bossy Girl
text_block_list.text:
Very well. But beware, our Mei-Mei Gang 
has zero tolerance for slacking! As the 
rookie, you'll have to work your tail off!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes ma'am! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, struggling right from the 
start, Meisho Doto gave it her all 
fighting as the team's newest rookie—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... I can't go on anymoreee...! 
You're all just way too energeticcc...!

text_block_list.name: Bossy Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Don't let your guard down! Slacking 
on watch duty during Cops and Robbers is 
against the rules!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But Boss... Aren't we the only ones left 
on the Robbers team who haven't been 
caught yet...?

text_block_list.name: Bossy Girl
text_block_list.text:
You dummy! If we just bust everyone out of 
jail, we can make a massive comeback!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Boy
text_block_list.text: Aha, found the Boss! Prepare yourself!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, at this rate the Boss is gonna... 
The Boss is gonna get caught! I-If that's 
the case... then at least!

text_block_list.name: Bossy Girl
text_block_list.text: Wha—!? Rookie...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll hold them off hereeee! Boss, hurry 
and save the othersss!

text_block_list.name: Bossy Girl
text_block_list.text:
Kuh... Rookie, I'll never forget your 
sacrificeee!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, amidst such dramatic moments, the 
fan exchange event drew to a close—

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
Well, folks, our fun event has come to an 
end! Everyone, please get home safely!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ph-Phew~... I'm exhausted. In the end, I 
was just getting dragged around the whole 
time... I wasn't able to take care of them 
properly at all...

text_block_list.name: Bossy Girl
text_block_list.text: —No way.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bossy Girl
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna say goodbye to Doto! Come 
home with us, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Kids
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! Play with us foreeeveeer!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, awawawawa...! Ev-Everyone, please 
don't cryyy~...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
There, there, everyone! Isn't that 
amazing?! It means everyone had a ton of 
fun playing with Doto-chan!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eh... D-Do you really think so...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Otherwise they totally wouldn't 
be crying like this!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...! I thought I was 
completely useless, but I really managed 
to... Uuu, now I'm gonna start crying 
toooo...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, it-it's okay, everywon! The event is 
over, but I'll always be here at the 
academy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So please... come visit and play again 
whenever you want!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Meisho Doto comforted the 
fussing children... and bid them a fond, 
reluctant farewell.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, it-it's okay, everywon! The event is 
over, but I'll always be at the academy—

text_block_list.name: Bossy Girl
text_block_list.text:
Charge all at once, everyone! Let's just 
take Doto home with us~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyoeeeh!? Noooooo waaaaayyyy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, swarmed and mobbed by the 
children, Meisho Doto was carried off 
somewhere.
